snippet.title: Whisk - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Whisk is a two-player platformer about shared movement and communication. You’ll coordinate leaps and grabs as Luna and Foam, to send all the Dreamcats home. Scout your route. Dash, leap, throw. Trust.  Dash through surreal worlds as Luna and Foam. Rescue Dreamcats by launching them into interdimensional portals.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602270/Whisk/

Developer: Double Dusk
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/doubleduskteam/

#indiegame #multiplayer #coop #platformer
